name: pr-quest
description: Gamified dashboard for the PRs you're asked to review, with Cursor review agents

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,ui --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "yarn workspace @pr-quest/server dev" "yarn workspace @pr-quest/web dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names api,ui --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "yarn workspace @pr-quest/server start" "yarn workspace @pr-quest/web dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && yarn workspaces foreach --all --exclude pr-quest run typecheck
